column18: The aim of this prospective randomized controlled trial was to compare the efficacy of a combination of oral and intravenous antibiotics with intravenous antibiotics alone on the incidence of surgical site infection in patients undergoing elective laparoscopic colorectal surgery.
column24: The primary endpoint is the incidence of overall surgical site infection.
column25: The secondary endpoints are the incidence of incisional site infections, organ/space infections, and enterocolitis.
column34: Institution is not considered as adjustment factor.
column40: Patients assigned to the non-Oral group received 1 g of cefmetazole intravenously 30 min before the skin incision, then every 3 h during and immediately after the operation, stopping 24 h after completion of surgery.
column41: Patients assigned to the Oral group received 750 mg of metronidazole and 1000 mg of kanamycin orally at 15:00 and 21:00 on the day before the surgery in addition to the same antibiotic regimen as the patients in the non-Oral group.
